name: model-meter
description: Shows which Claude model and effort level the session is using, in 8-bit style.

placement.title: Where the badge shows
placement.description: footer: only the badge in the footer. auto: the footer, plus an 8-bit band above the prompt while the terminal is wide (see autoMinColumns). band: the footer, plus the band whenever it fits.

autoMinColumns.title: Columns for the band in auto
autoMinColumns.description: With placement auto, the band shows from this terminal width on, and goes once the terminal is 20 columns narrower. From 80 to 400.
